_readme: One-time backfill INPUT for apps.default_branch_landing, determined 2026-08-02 (WS-P2.29).
NOT a source of truth and nothing reads it at runtime: App Brain's own column is the record.
It exists so the determination is reviewable in the pull request and re-runnable, the same
landing: 'redeploys' = merging advances something already serving with no further human act.
'inert'     = nothing already serving changes until a separate act.
There is no 'unknown' here on purpose — every one of the 25 registered apps was determined.
An app nobody assessed simply has no row, and holds NULL, which serves as 'unknown'.
github_repo is set only where App Brain currently holds NULL and a real repository exists;
it is gap-fill, never an overwrite, matching sync_deployment_from_coolify.py's own policy.
THREE INDEPENDENT MECHANISMS produce 'redeploys' in this estate, and reading CI finds only
the first: (1) a workflow step that calls the deploy target, (2) a repository webhook pointed
at the deploy target, (3) the hosting platform's own git integration, which needs no workflow
and no webhook in the repository at all.
